condition: exposed R156 ordinary list, all 1798 directed records and six directions, no extra source training, no FINAL or selection by task GT
H: D xy and common-sampled-PCA yaw, A z, length, width and height, from the exact sealed R156 A_pca and D_pca
holdout: Same physical A frame. Remove A and D native proposal samples AND all exact XYZ aliases, including R155 common PCA which used A's sample. R131 physical A/B registration can separately have looked at the raw cloud. Report accepted, tried and no attempt; label end-to-end strict separately.
geometry: Require positive 3-D intersection of A and D, and horizontal centers inside each other's oriented A/H footprint. In the shared near footprint require one uniquely dominant connected component supported in both, at least four 26-neighbour voxels and eight unique returns; grid v=clip(0.15*min(A dimensions),0.10,0.30)m. Elevation central 80%, same local point set for A and H, uniform total vote per occupied voxel.
scores: Primary ray: strict improvement in same-point first-positive-ray-intersection range error with verified sensor reference origin. Absolute errors truncated at max(0.2m,0.5*min(A horizontal lengths)), missed rays cost the cap. Origin/cluster/points unavailable or ambiguous => A. Record misses. Secondary origin-free unsigned distance to finite box boundary, inside/outside correct, same clipping/voxel weights. Secondary hybrid: use ray if available, otherwise surface. Never use camera center as laser origin. Also include same-direction equal-switch count shuffled controls within each eligible pool, and include all fallbacks in task metrics.
report: A, D, H, GT maximum A/H and A/D postseal; actual decisions, eligible oracle, all direction results, positive and negative weighted contributions, all R156 negative cases, source opportunity vs within-pool discrimination and wrong comparisons. Direction macro is design-weighted within direction and equal across directions; raw secondary.
success_conditional: If realized prelocked ray has strictly positive six-direction design-weighted mIoU over A, run one episodic parameter step supervised by that signal and compare to identical direct selection. If ray unsupported/flat/negative but prelocked ray-else-surface is positive, run using the declared hybrid while identifying the actual source of supervision. Otherwise stop before TTA. Qualification is for testing, not proof of deployment.
parameter_test: On accepted rows retain winner, A extents and altitude, accepted H yaw. Start xy at native frozen A. Use a single normalized gradient step of the accepted local held-out surface or ray error through actual last center layer's horizontal weight and bias rows. Freeze original hidden features, no fitted yaw parameter in 3EED. Use displacement magnitude equal to half the A-to-H XY distance; no step if gradient numerically zero. Include direct H and identical box-space gradient step, and half displacement toward H (interpolation) as no-update controls. Surface/occlusion gate fixed beforehand. No per-direction tuning.
reference: WeakM3D ICLR 2022 sections 3.3/3.4 use ray correspondence and density balancing during weakly supervised source training. R157 instead uses these concepts for a test-time paired geometry decision on real held-out returns.
